note: The fixed vocabulary of templates-regime/, mined from 10 of its 10 templates by enums.mjs. Kept in templates-enum/, never inside templates-regime/ itself, so nothing that scans templates-regime/ for its own templates ever trips over this file. A field with more than 100 distinct values, or one that is close to a different value in every file, is not here — it is data, not an enum. Edit the source templates and re-run enums.mjs to update this.
